archetypes.name: Process / Oil & Gas Facility
civil_interfaces: equipment foundations and anchor-bolt setting for vessels/compressors
bunded tank farm slabs and containment
commissioning_focus: mechanical completion by system/subsystem then loop checks
hydrotest and reinstatement of process piping
rotating-equipment run-in (pumps/compressors) with alignment and vibration
N2 purge / leak test / dry-out before hydrocarbon introduction
firewater ring and deluge functional test
SIS/ESD loop and cause-effect proving before first feed
archetypes.notes: Piping-dominant EPC. Spool fabrication + rotating equipment + tanks/vessels are the schedule drivers; commissioning is system/subsystem-based (mechanical completion → loop → start-up), not area-based. Insulation/coating and heat-tracing sit on the critical path to weatherization. Hazardous-area electrical and firewater/deluge are safety-critical and gate start-up.

archetypes.name: Chemical / Petrochemical / Refinery Complex
civil_interfaces: heavy reactor/column foundations and pile caps
tank farm bunds and impervious liners
underground process sewers and effluent/neutralization networks
commissioning_focus: subsystem mechanical completion → loop check → pre-commissioning
utility-first sequence (steam, N2, instrument air, cooling water) before process
tightness/leak test and passivation of alloy piping
distributed control system (DCS/SIS) integration and interlock proving
archetypes.notes: Like oil & gas but denser process piping, more alloy/exotic metallurgy driving spool fab lead times, and heavy insulation/heat-tracing scope. Utilities (steam, cooling water, instrument air, N2) must be commissioned first — utility-block readiness is the gating milestone. Effluent/neutralization and flare systems are compliance-critical.

archetypes.name: Power Generation / Utility Plant
civil_interfaces: turbine/generator pedestal and heavy machine foundations
underground cable trenches and earthing grid
commissioning_focus: boiler/HRSG hydrotest, chemical clean and steam blow
turbine-generator run-up, overspeed and vibration proving
high-voltage energization, protection and synchronization to grid
first fire → first sync → reliability/performance run
archetypes.notes: Rotating machinery (turbine-generator) and high-voltage electrical dominate. The earthing grid and HV protection/energization are first-class, not secondary MEP. Commissioning is a long, tightly-sequenced chain (steam blow → first fire → sync → reliability run) that owns the back end of the schedule. Applies to gas, steam, combined-cycle and large renewables/BESS interconnection.

archetypes.name: Water / Wastewater Treatment Plant
civil_interfaces: large water-retaining concrete structures (tanks, basins, clarifiers) with watertightness
buried inlet/outlet and interconnecting process pipelines
pump-station wet wells and dry wells
cable and duct banks to MCC/control building
commissioning_focus: clean-water functional run of pumps, blowers, valves and dosing
process/biological seeding and dirty-water commissioning to consent
SCADA/PLC loop checks and telemetry integration
archetypes.notes: Civil-heavy: watertight concrete basins and buried pipework are the enabling long-lead scope, so civil_interface is nearly a primary system here. Pumps, blowers, dosing skids and instrumentation are the mechanical core. Two-stage commissioning (clean-water then dirty/biological seeding) with a regulatory consent gate is characteristic and back-loaded.

archetypes.name: Heavy Industrial Factory / Process Plant
civil_interfaces: heavy machine/press foundations with isolation and inertia blocks
crane rail and portal-frame steel foundations
commissioning_focus: utility readiness (power, compressed air, cooling, steam) before line energization
individual machine/skid FAT-to-SAT and dry runs
conveyor and material-handling line integration and interlocks
production-line integrated run and no-load → loaded ramp-up
archetypes.notes: First-class industrial archetype: mixed process + discrete equipment tied together by conveying/material-handling and packaged skids. Structural steel (portal frames, mezzanines, crane rails) and heavy machine foundations are enablers on the critical path. Commissioning is line/cell-based with a no-load → loaded production ramp; utilities must land first. Sits between pure process plants and light manufacturing.

archetypes.name: Light / Discrete Manufacturing & Assembly Plant
civil_interfaces: level power-floated production slabs to tight flatness tolerance
service trenches and floor ducts for utilities
commissioning_focus: clean/dry utilities to point of use (power, air, water, exhaust)
machine SAT, conveyor/AGV line integration and interlock testing
HVAC/environmental control balance and (if applicable) cleanroom qualification
line integrated dry run then production ramp-up
archetypes.notes: Lighter than the heavy industrial factory: process piping is minor, but material handling (conveyors/AGVs), packaged machines and HVAC/environmental control dominate. Floor flatness and equipment plinths are key civil enablers. For pharma/food/electronics variants, HVAC becomes cleanroom qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) and moves toward primary.

archetypes.name: Silo / Grain / Bulk Materials Terminal
civil_interfaces: deep silo raft/pile foundations and slip-formed or bolted silo civils
commissioning_focus: conveyor and transfer-chute belt run, tracking and no-load proving
elevator/bucket and diverter interlock and sequencing test
no-load → loaded bulk-flow trial and throughput verification
archetypes.notes: Bulk-handling archetype dominated by conveying, silos/tanks as storage vessels, and structural steel galleries/towers. No process piping to speak of; instrumentation centres on level/weight/flow. Dust explosion protection (venting/suppression) and earthing are safety-critical. Deep silo foundations are the long-lead civil enabler. Commissioning is a bulk-flow throughput trial, not a chemical start-up.

archetypes.name: Rail / Metro / Transit System
civil_interfaces: trackbed, tunnels, viaducts and station box civils
traction power substation foundations and cable routes
signalling equipment room and trackside cabinet bases
commissioning_focus: signalling/CBTC integration, interlocking and train-detection proving
tunnel ventilation and life-safety (fire/smoke) system proving
trial running, dynamic testing and system-integration/safety-case sign-off
archetypes.notes: Systems archetype where power (traction/aux), signalling (instrumentation), cabling containment and earthing/bonding dominate over process/mechanical scope. Conveying appears as escalators/lifts. Commissioning is dominated by signalling integration and a long trial-running / safety-case regime — the true schedule and risk driver. Deep civil (tunnels, station boxes, viaducts) is the enabling backbone.

archetypes.name: Data Center / Mission-Critical Facility
civil_interfaces: generator, transformer and chiller-yard foundations and bunds
raised-floor / slab flatness and equipment plinths
utility duct banks and incoming HV routes
commissioning_focus: Level 1–5 commissioning (factory → site → integrated systems test)
utility → generator → UPS → PDU power-path proving with load banks
chilled-water and CRAC/CRAH cooling capacity and redundancy (N+1) test
integrated systems test (IST) with black-building / failure-mode pull-the-plug
BMS/EPMS integration, VESDA and clean-agent fire suppression proving
archetypes.notes: Redundancy-and-resilience archetype: electrical power path (utility/gen/UPS/PDU) plus mechanical cooling (chilled water, CRAC/CRAH) are co-dominant, tied together by BMS/EPMS. Commissioning is the defining discipline — formal Level 1–5 with load-bank and integrated systems test / failure-mode proving that owns the back end. Fire (VESDA + clean agent) and structured cabling containment are first-class.

archetypes.name: Hospital / Healthcare Facility
civil_interfaces: plant-room and rooftop AHU/chiller structural provisions
medical-gas manifold room and bulk oxygen/tank compound civils
commissioning_focus: specialist HVAC balance and validation (operating theatres/isolation rooms, pressure cascades, HEPA)
medical gas pipeline system (MGPS) purity, pressure and alarm certification
essential/emergency power changeover and UPS proving
infection-control and clinical-area handover with regulatory sign-off
archetypes.notes: MEP-intensive critical facility. HVAC is primary and specialized (theatre air changes, pressure cascades, HEPA filtration validation) and medical-gas piping is a safety-critical variant of utility piping requiring formal certification. Redundant essential power and life-safety systems gate occupancy. Commissioning is validation-and-certification heavy with clinical handover, not industrial start-up.

archetypes.name: Commercial High-Rise / Mixed-Use Building
civil_interfaces: core walls, MEP riser shafts and floor penetrations
rooftop plant and cooling-tower structural provisions
commissioning_focus: vertical riser distribution (power, water, HVAC) proving floor-by-floor
lift/escalator installation, load and safety testing
fire detection, sprinkler, smoke-control and stair-pressurization cause-effect
BMS integration and integrated life-safety fire matrix test before occupancy
archetypes.notes: Vertical building archetype driven by MEP risers, vertical transportation (lifts/escalators as the conveying system) and life-safety (fire suppression, smoke control, stair pressurization). Commissioning centres on the integrated fire/life-safety cause-effect matrix that gates occupancy certificate. Structural steel/core is the enabler; process systems are absent.

archetypes.name: Linear / Civil Infrastructure (Roads, Bridges, Pipelines, Ports)
civil_interfaces: bridge and structure foundations, piers and deck civils
buried pipeline trenching, bedding and reinstatement
port/marine quay, jetty and dredging works
duct banks, chambers and cable/pipe crossings
commissioning_focus: structural load/proof testing and survey verification
pipeline hydrotest, pigging and cathodic-protection energization
roadside/tunnel M&E, lighting and ITS/SCADA integration
handover to operator against design and regulatory acceptance
archetypes.notes: Civil-dominant catch-all where earthworks, structures and buried networks are the primary scope and MEP is a lighter overlay (roadside/tunnel systems, ITS, lighting, pump stations). Pipeline variants pull in spool fabrication, hydrotest, pigging and cathodic protection. Commissioning is proof/acceptance testing and operator handover rather than a plant start-up. Use as the fallback archetype for linear and marine civil works.

archetypes.name: Residential Building (Generic)
archetypes.finishing_sequence_note: Structure/blockwork → MEP first fix in walls & slab → plaster/board & waterproofing to wet areas → screed/tiling → second fix MEP → paint → joinery & sanitary fixtures → snagging → handover. Wet areas (bath/kitchen) gate the tiling and fixture chain.
archetypes.notes: Baseline residential template — apply when the schedule does not distinguish rise/typology. Finishing + light MEP first/second fix dominate the critical review; heavy plant/industrial systems are absent.

archetypes.name: Apartment Building
archetypes.finishing_sequence_note: Repetitive typical-floor cycle: unit blockwork → MEP first fix → wet-area waterproofing → screed & tiling → second fix → paint → joinery/sanitary → per-unit snag. Common cores (corridors, lobbies, risers) run as a parallel finishing front feeding vertical MEP.
archetypes.notes: Multi-unit repetition is the planning signature — typical-floor productivity and unit-to-unit handover cadence drive the programme. Risers and common-area MEP interface with every unit stack.

archetypes.name: Low-Rise Residential (G+1 to G+3)
archetypes.finishing_sequence_note: Short vertical run, finishing-dominant: blockwork → MEP first fix → wet-area waterproofing → plaster → screed/tiling → second fix → paint → joinery & fixtures → snag. Roof waterproofing and external render gate weather-tightness.
archetypes.notes: Simpler, finishing-led with minimal vertical MEP coordination. No fire-fighting risers or lifts typically; commissioning is light and unit/floor-based.

archetypes.name: Mid-Rise Residential (G+4 to G+9)
archetypes.finishing_sequence_note: Typical-floor repetition with an emerging vertical MEP spine: floor cycle feeds unit finishing (first fix → waterproofing → tiling → second fix → paint → joinery/fixtures) while cores, risers and stairs carry building-wide services. Fire alarm coverage becomes a coordinated floor-by-floor activity.
archetypes.notes: Transition band — finishing still dominates but vertical services (risers, fire alarm, lift-lobby MEP) start driving coordination. Life-safety commissioning appears but remains lighter than high-rise.

archetypes.name: High-Rise Residential (G+10 and above)
archetypes.finishing_sequence_note: Core/jumpform leads, typical-floor finishing follows several floors below in a rolling wave. Vertical MEP spine (wet/dry risers, pump rooms, roof tanks, lift shafts) must be sequenced with the floor cycle; each unit still runs the first-fix→waterproofing→tiling→second-fix→fixtures chain, but building-wide life-safety and vertical transport gate handover.
archetypes.notes: Vertical MEP coordination dominates alongside finishing. Adds fire fighting (risers/sprinklers/pumps), fire alarm zoning, lifts, roof plant, and BMS-lite. Finishing is high-volume/repetitive but no longer the sole critical path — vertical services and life-safety commissioning share it.

archetypes.name: Residential Compound / Gated Community
archetypes.finishing_sequence_note: Repeated villa/townhouse type finished as a rolling front across plots, gated by site infrastructure (roads, utilities, external lighting). Each unit follows the villa finishing chain; landscaping, pools and boundary works close out the plot before community-level handover.
archetypes.notes: Horizontal repetition across many identical low-rise units plus shared site infrastructure. Planning signature is plot-by-plot productivity and utility/road enablement rather than vertical MEP. Commissioning is light and per-unit, with community-level utility and security systems layered on top.

archetypes.name: Townhouse (Attached Unit)
archetypes.finishing_sequence_note: Attached low-rise unit, finishing-dominant: blockwork → MEP first fix → wet-area waterproofing → plaster → tiling → second fix → paint → joinery & fixtures → snag. Party-wall interface and shared services coordination with the adjacent unit is the only added complexity.
archetypes.notes: Essentially a villa in an attached row — simple, finishing-led, minimal commissioning. Repeats across a terrace; party-wall and shared-services coordination distinguish it from the standalone villa.

archetypes.name: Villa (Detached, High-Spec)
archetypes.finishing_sequence_note: High-spec finishing dominates the entire back half of the programme: blockwork → MEP first fix → wet-area/pool waterproofing → plaster → marble/stone tiling → second fix → paint → bespoke joinery → premium sanitary fixtures → intensive snagging. Stone/marble lead times and joinery quality gate handover.
archetypes.notes: Finishing-dominant with premium materials (marble, stone, bespoke joinery) — the review focus is the finishing-to-MEP interface and material lead times, not plant. Minimal industrial/commissioning content; often includes pool and landscape interfaces.

archetypes.name: Standalone House
archetypes.finishing_sequence_note: Simplest residential form: blockwork → MEP first fix → wet-area waterproofing → plaster → screed/tiling → second fix → paint → joinery & fixtures → snag. Roof waterproofing and external render gate weather-tightness before internal finishing accelerates.
archetypes.notes: Baseline single-dwelling template — finishing-led, minimal MEP coordination, light per-house commissioning. Use for detached houses without villa-grade material or pool/landscape complexity.

archetypes.name: Mixed-Use Residential (Residential over Retail/Podium)
archetypes.finishing_sequence_note: Two finishing regimes: retail/podium shell-and-core (often left as landlord shell) and the residential tower typical-floor finishing wave above. Vertical services must stay continuous through the transfer/podium level; residential units run the standard first-fix→waterproofing→tiling→second-fix→fixtures chain while podium and cores demand coordinated life-safety and MEP segregation.
archetypes.notes: Combines high-rise residential vertical MEP with a retail/podium interface. Review focus is the residential-to-commercial services segregation, transfer-level MEP continuity, and phased zoned handover (retail vs residential). Heaviest commissioning of the residential set due to shared life-safety and metering separation.

archetypes.name: Roads & Highways
civil_interfaces: duct banks & pull-pits for ITS and lighting cabling
archetypes.applicability: At-grade or elevated road and motorway corridors where earthworks and pavement dominate and MEP is limited to lighting, power and ITS/traffic systems.
archetypes.notes: Civil-led; systems review weights lighting/ITS power and cabling containment. Tunnelled sections should be reviewed under the tunnels archetype.

archetypes.name: Bridges & Viaducts
archetypes.applicability: Spanning structures (road, rail or pedestrian) where the superstructure governs and MEP is limited to lighting, structural monitoring and lightning protection.
archetypes.notes: Structure is the enabler; bearings and expansion joints are structural but commissioning-critical. Systems focus is monitoring, feature/navigation lighting and lightning protection.

archetypes.name: Tunnels (road / rail / utility)
archetypes.applicability: Bored or cut-and-cover tunnels where life-safety ventilation, fire suppression and SCADA/tunnel-management systems dominate the fit-out over the civil lining.
archetypes.notes: Among the most MEP-intensive linear types; ventilation and fire cause-and-effect are the dominant review risk. Utility tunnels carry a lighter systems scope (lighting, power, drainage) than road/rail.

archetypes.name: Airport Passenger Terminal
archetypes.applicability: Passenger terminal buildings where baggage handling, security/ELV and large-volume HVAC/fire systems are the review focus over the enclosing long-span structure.
archetypes.notes: Baggage handling (conveying) and security/ELV are the signature systems distinguishing this from a generic commercial building. Airside pavements are a separate archetype.

archetypes.name: Airport Airside (runway / taxiway / apron)
civil_interfaces: subgrade & pavement (PQC / asphalt) for runway, taxiway & apron
archetypes.applicability: Runway, taxiway and apron works where pavement dominates and MEP is limited to airfield ground lighting, primary power distribution and navaids.
archetypes.notes: Civil-led pavement type; the specialised electrical scope is AGL (constant-current series circuits) and navaids rather than conventional building power.

archetypes.name: Container Terminal
commissioning_focus: STS / RTG / RMG crane power & rail energisation
archetypes.applicability: Container port terminals where quay-crane power, reefer distribution and yard electrical/lighting dominate over the marine civil works.
archetypes.notes: Handling equipment (cranes) is treated as mechanical_equipment fed by high-power electrical; the review focus is power distribution, reefer racks and yard lighting, not the quay structure.

archetypes.name: Bulk (Dry / Liquid) Terminal
commissioning_focus: conveyor & stacker / reclaimer / ship-loader run-in & interlocks
archetypes.applicability: Dry- or liquid-bulk marine terminals where material-handling conveyors/loaders (or tank-farm piping) and their power/SCADA are the systems focus.
archetypes.notes: Dry bulk weights conveying/material-handling and dust-explosion protection; liquid bulk shifts toward tanks_vessels, process_piping and pumps. One archetype covering both bulk modes.

archetypes.name: Jetty / Quay / Berth Structure
archetypes.applicability: Piled or gravity marine berthing structures (jetty, quay, dolphin) where the marine structure governs and MEP is limited to berth services, lighting and mooring aids.
archetypes.notes: Marine structure is the enabler; systems are berth services. Fuel/product berths add fire-foam and process/utility piping that a general cargo berth does not.

archetypes.name: Metro / Rail Station
archetypes.applicability: Individual metro or rail station boxes where station ventilation, vertical transportation, fire and station systems dominate the fit-out over the civil box.
archetypes.notes: Station-level companion to the existing rail_metro (line/system-wide) archetype; vertical transportation (conveying) and ventilation/smoke-control are the signature systems.

archetypes.name: Railway Track & Systems
archetypes.applicability: Linear railway corridors where trackform, traction power (OHLE), signalling and telecoms are the systems focus rather than a discrete building.
archetypes.notes: Linear systems type; signalling (instrumentation) and traction power (electrical_power) are the dominant review risk. Structure/trackbed is the enabler.

archetypes.name: Pumping Station (water / wastewater / stormwater)
archetypes.applicability: Water, wastewater or stormwater pumping stations where pumps, process piping and electrical/SCADA control are the review focus.
archetypes.notes: Compact but MEP-dense; rotating equipment (pumps) with process piping and instrumentation is the core. Surge protection and duty/standby control are the classic commissioning risks.

archetypes.name: Dam & Hydraulic Structure
civil_interfaces: dam body (embankment / RCC / concrete) & foundation grouting
archetypes.applicability: Dams, weirs and major hydraulic structures where the mass-civil structure governs and systems are limited to hydromechanical gates, monitoring and their controls.
archetypes.notes: Mass-civil enabler; the reviewable systems are hydromechanical (gates/valves/hoists), dam-safety instrumentation and their power/controls. First-filling is a distinctive commissioning milestone.

archetypes.name: Utilities Distribution Network
archetypes.applicability: Networked or linear distribution of water, power, gas or telecom across a site or municipality where buried piping and cabling in trenches/ducts dominate.
archetypes.notes: Linear/networked type composed of buried utility piping and cabling; civil is trenching/ducts/chambers. Live tie-ins and switchover are the high-risk commissioning steps.

archetypes.name: Shopping Mall / Retail Center
commissioning_focus: vertical transport (escalators, travelators, lifts) load and safety
central plant to AHU/FCU air balancing across the mall
tenant fit-out interface handover and base-build sign-off
archetypes.applicability: Applies to enclosed or semi-enclosed retail centers with large public assembly areas, atria, food courts and multiple leasable tenant units.
archetypes.notes: Life-safety integration (smoke evacuation + fire + PA + lift homing) and vertical transport dominate the schedule; base-build vs tenant fit-out boundary is the recurring interface risk.

archetypes.name: Hotel / Hospitality Building
commissioning_focus: guest-room mock-up and typical-floor sign-off driving repetitive fit-out
domestic hot-water, drainage and water-quality flushing
archetypes.applicability: Applies to hotels, resorts and serviced-apartment towers with many repetitive guest rooms plus intensive wet areas and back-of-house.
archetypes.notes: Highly repetitive MEP per key with heavy finishing/joinery; wet-area waterproofing and DHW are the classic snag sources; guest-room mock-up gates the repetition.

archetypes.name: School / Education Facility
commissioning_focus: ventilation and lighting compliance for teaching spaces
archetypes.applicability: Applies to primary/secondary schools and standalone teaching buildings with classrooms, halls, labs and sports/canteen areas.
archetypes.notes: Moderate MEP intensity; the binding constraint is a fixed academic-year occupancy date, so life-safety and IT/AV sign-off pace handover.

archetypes.name: University / Higher-Education Campus
commissioning_focus: central plant and campus-wide utility distribution (power, chilled water, data)
laboratory services (fume extract, lab gases, specialist HVAC)
archetypes.applicability: Applies to multi-building higher-education campuses combining teaching blocks, laboratories, libraries and residences fed from shared central utilities.
archetypes.notes: Distinguished from a single school by campus-scale shared utilities and lab services; commissioning is phased and depends on the central plant being live first.

archetypes.name: Mosque / Religious Building
commissioning_focus: public-address / acoustic system tuning for prayer hall
high-grade finishing, cladding and dome/minaret works
archetypes.applicability: Applies to mosques, churches and other worship buildings with a large single-volume assembly hall, ceremonial finishing and ablution facilities.
archetypes.notes: Sound/PA and ablution water are the functional cores; finishing quality (stone, joinery, domes) is disproportionately schedule-critical relative to plant complexity.

archetypes.name: Sports Stadium / Arena
commissioning_focus: mass-egress crowd life-safety (voice evacuation, CCTV, access)
broadcast, AV, scoreboard and IT infrastructure
spectator-bowl comfort ventilation and concourse services
archetypes.applicability: Applies to stadiums, arenas and large spectator venues with a long-span roof, tiered seating bowl and high-density crowd flows.
archetypes.notes: Crowd safety and broadcast/AV drive the venue; long-span structural steel roof is the dominant civil interface gating the MEP that hangs from it.

archetypes.name: Warehouse / Logistics / Distribution Center
commissioning_focus: ESFR / in-rack sprinkler system and fire pumps
racking, conveyor and material-handling / ASRS integration
warehouse management system and dock equipment
archetypes.applicability: Applies to distribution centers, high-bay warehouses and fulfillment buildings dominated by storage racking and material handling rather than occupancy comfort.
archetypes.notes: Fire suppression (ESFR) and MHE/conveyor integration are the schedule drivers; super-flat floor slab and dock levelers are the critical civil interfaces for racking and trucks.

archetypes.name: Multi-Storey / Parking Structure
commissioning_focus: CO/jet-fan or ducted car-park ventilation cause-and-effect
fire detection, suppression and smoke control
access control / ANPR and payment systems
archetypes.applicability: Applies to standalone or podium multi-storey car parks and structured parking where ventilation, drainage and vehicle access are the functional systems.
archetypes.notes: Sparse MEP but ventilation life-safety and deck waterproofing dominate; post-tensioned/precast decks are the main civil interface and set MEP fixing sequence.

archetypes.name: Cold Storage / Refrigerated Warehouse
commissioning_focus: refrigeration plant pull-down and temperature mapping
ammonia/CO2 refrigerant safety and leak detection
dry-pipe/ESFR fire protection compatible with freezer temperatures
archetypes.applicability: Applies to refrigerated and frozen storage facilities where the insulated envelope and refrigeration plant define the building rather than comfort HVAC.
archetypes.notes: Refrigeration (as HVAC), insulated envelope and refrigerant safety are the cores; heated/vapor-sealed slab is a critical civil interface to prevent frost heave.

archetypes.name: Cement Plant
commissioning_focus: kiln refractory installation and controlled dry-out / heat-up
crusher, raw/cement mill and conveyor no-load then loaded runs
process control sequence (weigh feeders, separators, dust collection)
archetypes.applicability: Applies to clinker and cement production plants centred on kiln, mills, crushers, silos and bulk material conveying.
archetypes.notes: Heavy rotating/process equipment on massive foundations; kiln refractory dry-out and staged mill/conveyor loading are the classic commissioning gates.

archetypes.name: Steel Plant / Steelworks
commissioning_focus: overhead crane and roll-line mechanical alignment
process media systems (fuel gas, oxygen, cooling water)
staged cold then hot start-up of the production line
archetypes.applicability: Applies to steelmaking and rolling facilities with furnaces, casters, rolling mills, heavy cranes and gas/water media systems.
archetypes.notes: Very heavy foundations, crane rails and media piping; hot commissioning of furnace/caster with media systems live is the dominant integration risk.

archetypes.name: Mineral / Mining Processing Plant
commissioning_focus: crushing and grinding (mill) circuit no-load then ore-load runs
slurry pumping, thickeners and process-water systems
wet commissioning through to first product / concentrate
archetypes.applicability: Applies to ore processing and beneficiation plants (crush, grind, separate) handling slurry, tailings and bulk material conveying.
archetypes.notes: Crushing/grinding circuit and slurry pumping dominate; heavy foundations, chutework and tailings interfaces are the key civil enablers.

archetypes.name: Pharmaceutical / Life-Sciences Plant
commissioning_focus: cleanroom HVAC qualification and classification (particle, pressure cascade)
clean utilities (WFI, purified water, clean steam, compressed gases)
archetypes.applicability: Applies to GMP pharmaceutical, biotech and life-sciences facilities where cleanroom classification and validation govern acceptance.
archetypes.notes: Cleanroom HVAC, high-purity utilities and formal CQV/validation are the review focus; cleanroom finishes and pressure cascades make finishing a functional (not cosmetic) system.

archetypes.name: Food & Beverage Processing Plant
commissioning_focus: hygienic (sanitary) process piping passivation and slope
process line integration with utilities (steam, refrigeration, CO2)
hygiene-zone HVAC and HACCP / food-safety sign-off
archetypes.applicability: Applies to food, dairy and beverage plants with hygienic process lines, CIP and controlled hygiene zones.
archetypes.notes: Hygienic/sanitary piping, CIP and hygiene-zone HVAC are the cores; hygienic floors, drainage falls and washdown define the critical civil interface.

archetypes.name: Pulp & Paper Mill
commissioning_focus: paper machine drive and roll-train alignment
pulp, chemical and white/black-liquor process lines
archetypes.applicability: Applies to pulp mills and paper machines with digesters, large rotating machine lines, steam and chemical recovery systems.
archetypes.notes: Massive rotating machine line on precision foundations plus steam and chemical piping; drive alignment and steam systems gate the wet-end start-up.

archetypes.name: Glass Manufacturing Plant
commissioning_focus: furnace refractory build and controlled heat-up
float bath (tin) and lehr annealing systems
batch house and forming/conveyor line start-up
archetypes.applicability: Applies to float and container glass plants centred on a melting furnace, forming line, annealing lehr and batch handling.
archetypes.notes: Refractory (insulation_coating) and furnace heat-up dominate; combustion (gas/oxygen) and forming line commissioning follow the furnace being brought to temperature.

archetypes.name: Desalination Plant
commissioning_focus: high-pressure pumping and RO membrane loading
archetypes.applicability: Applies to seawater/brackish RO (or thermal) desalination plants producing potable/process water via membrane or thermal trains.
archetypes.notes: High-pressure pumps and RO trains with extensive process piping are the cores; marine intake/outfall and basin structures are the defining civil interfaces.

archetypes.name: Electrical Substation / Switchyard
commissioning_focus: protection relay, SCADA and control-system point-to-point
HV switchgear/transformer testing and staged energization
earthing / grounding grid verification and step-touch
transformer oil, cooling and Buchholz/protection functional checks
archetypes.applicability: Applies to HV/MV substations and switchyards (AIS/GIS) with transformers, switchgear, protection and a control building.
archetypes.notes: Power apparatus, earthing grid and protection/SCADA are the focus; equipment foundations, cable trenches and oil-containment bunds are the civil enablers to energization.

archetypes.name: Solar PV Plant
commissioning_focus: inverter, transformer and grid interconnection energization
earthing / grounding and lightning protection verification
archetypes.applicability: Applies to utility-scale ground-mount (or large rooftop) photovoltaic plants with modules, trackers/racking, inverters and grid tie-in.
archetypes.notes: DC/AC electrical, earthing and racking steel dominate; pile foundations, grading and access roads are the civil enablers, with grid interconnection gating final commissioning.

archetypes.name: Wind Farm
commissioning_focus: turbine erection, bolt-torque and mechanical completion
collection network, transformer and grid interconnection
first rotation, grid-code compliance and power-curve verification
archetypes.applicability: Applies to onshore wind farms with multiple turbines, inter-array collection cabling and a grid connection substation.
archetypes.notes: Turbine erection (heavy lift), nacelle/generator and collection electrical are the cores; massive turbine foundations, crane hardstands and access roads are the defining civil interfaces.

archetypes.name: District Cooling Plant
commissioning_focus: distribution network hydraulic and pressure testing
BMS control, staging and energy-transfer-station interface
archetypes.applicability: Applies to central district cooling plants generating and distributing chilled water to multiple buildings via a piped network.
archetypes.notes: Chillers, large pumps and the buried distribution network are the cores; pump-station structures and network trenches/pipe racks are the civil interfaces, with TES a distinguishing feature.

archetypes.name: LNG Terminal / Liquefaction-Regasification
commissioning_focus: cryogenic piping cool-down and system inerting/purging
LNG storage tank commissioning (drying, purge, cool-down)
leak/pressure testing and cryogenic insulation integrity
fire & gas detection and safety-shutdown (ESD) functional testing
archetypes.applicability: Applies to LNG import/export terminals with cryogenic storage tanks, cryogenic piping, pumps/compressors and marine jetty interface.
archetypes.notes: Cryogenic piping, LNG tanks and cryogenic insulation are the cores with fire & gas safety heavily weighted; tank foundations and marine/jetty works are the defining civil interfaces.

archetypes.name: Tank Farm / Bulk Liquid Storage
commissioning_focus: tank hydrotest, settlement survey and calibration/strapping
transfer pumps, manifolds and interconnecting piping
tank gauging, overfill protection and instrumentation
archetypes.applicability: Applies to bulk liquid storage terminals (fuel, chemical, water) with multiple storage tanks, transfer piping and containment bunds.
archetypes.notes: Storage tanks, transfer piping and foam/deluge fire protection are the cores; tank ring-beam foundations and bund/containment are the critical civil interfaces, earthing important for flammable service.

archetypes.name: Waste-to-Energy / Incineration Plant
commissioning_focus: boiler hydrotest and steam-blow / chemical clean
waste feed (bunker, cranes, grate) and first-fire start-up
archetypes.applicability: Applies to municipal/industrial waste incineration and energy-recovery plants with combustion grate, boiler, steam turbine and flue-gas treatment.
archetypes.notes: Combustion/boiler and turbine islands with waste and ash handling are the cores; waste bunker and heavy foundations are the civil interfaces, and flue-gas treatment commissioning is emissions-critical.
